patterns.summary: Passwords or tokens compared with == leak timing.
checklist: Add a test that a wrong token of the same length is refused.

patterns.summary: The session id is kept after login.
checklist: Issue a new session id after a successful login.

patterns.summary: Access tokens are issued with no expiry.
checklist: Give every access token an expiry and test that an expired one is refused.

patterns.summary: User text is put into the page as HTML.
checklist: Set textContent, never innerHTML, for user text.
Use query parameters for every value.

patterns.summary: Login errors say whether the user exists.
checklist: Give the same message for a wrong user and a wrong password.

patterns.summary: Login has no limit on attempts.
checklist: Limit failed logins per account and per address.

patterns.summary: A password reset link works more than once.
checklist: Make a reset token single-use and short-lived.
